description:
Check the code the human typed, for the number the code was sent to. The result is the verification only when it is approved; every other outcome is a tool error with an `error.code`. Let the user in only when a check answers `200` with status `approved`; treat every other answer, a timeout and a network error as not approved.

Errors: `incorrect_code` (attempts remain), `too_many_attempts` (start a new verification), `recipient_mismatch` (`to` is not the number the code was sent to), `verification_expired`, `verification_closed` (already approved or replaced), `verification_not_found`. A wrong code costs an attempt, and five close the verification: do not retry a check by yourself; ask the human for the code again.

api_key.description: An sk_test_ key, for example from create_test_key. Leave it out to use the key in this MCP server's Authorization header. A live key (sk_live_) is refused here: tool arguments are kept in the conversation, so a live key belongs in the header.

code.description: The six digits the human typed, as a string.

to.description: The number the code was sent to, which your application is about to mark as verified.

name: check_verification
title: Check a verification code
